It is still judged not sound under G3 and P1's pre-declared coherence rule, on two grounds only: (i) a known-good row's accusation moves from two long readings on two axes and two chains to one statement on one chain, its support produced by deleting a contest that was metrically irrelevant (1600/1601 fit the same scale) — a change in what the decision rests on, not in its truth; (ii) P1 measures this conflict with the DROP view while the challenge it starts ranks with the frozen view, the mixed refutation definition its coherence rule flagged before the runs. This verdict is a judgement; the report states that the selection does NOT depend on it: were P1 admissible, N1 still wins by preregistered rule 2 (fewer consumers touched, 4 vs 5) and rule 3 (G9: P1 raises a trigger the incumbent did not, N1 none).
